title: Coastal watch
question: How much can a mark on a map honestly tell us?
suggestedCaption: A working maritime observation interface. Real coastline, synthetic tracks. Select a mark to inspect its source, timing and recorded movement; interrupt the stream to see what remains.

source.availability: Private application source; revision committed locally at capture time.

recording.method: 634 browser screenshot frames captured from the running application, encoded with their capture intervals at 30 output frames per second.
recording.edits: 10.85 seconds of uncaptured gaps removed with direct cuts. The interface clock can jump at those cuts. No fabricated observations or interpolated movement. Silent.
recording.dimensions: Native 1275 by 884 browser capture; video padded by one pixel for H.264 compatibility. No upscaling.

boundaries: Tracks and alert examples are synthetic; coastline is real Natural Earth public-domain land geometry.
Demo alerts are static fixtures independent of the moving vessel tracks.
Dashboard does not run the track-fusion pipeline. Quality is a demo heuristic, not identity or threat confidence.
Observation age and receipt age are distinct. Reconnection is manual through Reload preview and demo-role selection.
No operator comprehension study, operational validation or certification is established.
